title: Square 1220 x 1220 panel: identity and swap both fit
rationale: On a square panel the identity and swap maps give the same vertex set and INFO;27 matches either edge: ambiguous, refused with the remedy, never tie-broken (safety-model 12; PHYS-11). The vertex frame is not yet a recorded fact (gate panel_vertices_usable off), so every hypothesis is still allowed (safety-model 12, step 2; U-13 in safety-model 1.4): once rung R2 has recorded the identity frame only the identity is tried, and the stream would pass it alone, uniquely. The other gates are the baseline snapshot's. With the frame not a fact, uploads are gated off as well (G-GATE, gate panel_vertices_usable, rung R2); P-GEOM must still be among the refusals.
